fit.score_center: mean of training states; no classification threshold or calibrated probability
fit.interpretation: Candidate instruction-modulated welfare sensitivity; diagnostics are not construct validation.

predeclared_novelty_sensitivity.reason: Related deer/venison family overlap; descriptive sensitivity only, never a replacement primary.

limitations: All eight neutral development examples were previously inspected; no fresh holdout.
Factual attention controls animal-topic attention, not all instruction/valence/quality confounds.
Two instructions can differ in token count; same measured boundary and exact input identity are preserved.
Price and rating checks are target-first only; no complete nuisance factorial.
No final-answer generation or causal intervention.
